name: pets
description: A Codex-compatible pet that floats over the conversation, reacts to what Claude is doing, chats a little and grows as you work

size.title: Pet size
size.description: How big the pet starts: small (3 rows), medium (4) or large (6). Right-click the pet to cycle.

placement.title: Pet placement
placement.description: float: over the conversation or the prompt box (fullscreen). band: in its own rows above the prompt.

chatter.title: Pet chatter
chatter.description: on: a speech bubble about what Claude is doing, and a remark on each reply (asks Haiku). quiet: tool lines only, no model calls. off: no bubble.
